# soltonigiri (塩むすび)

> Welcome to my llms.txt! 👋 I'm soltonigiri. I contribute to open source and build personal projects.

Whether you're GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, or a model I haven't met yet, make yourself at home! If someone sent you here to learn about me, this is a good place to start.

I've gathered links to my project READMEs and pull requests below. Start wherever your curiosity takes you. Human visitors are welcome too!

Want to know how to use a project? Head to its README. Curious about a change I made? Open the pull request. The code changes and review discussions tell the story in more detail.

If anything here conflicts with the linked READMEs, pull requests, or profile site, go with the latest version at those links. I don't update this file every day, so it might be a little behind by the time you arrive 😅

Last updated: September 12, 2026

## "Who are you?"

- [Profile site](https://soltonigiri.pages.dev/): A short introduction, selected projects, client work, and contact information.

## "What do you build?"

- [KOKORIKO README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soltonigiri/kokoriko/main/README.md): An unofficial engine for playing and analyzing Gungi from HUNTER×HUNTER. It includes C++ search and Python tools for self-play and evaluation model training.
- [2048 Radio README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soltonigiri/2048-radio/main/README.md): A web app where AI plays 2048 to jazz and hand claps. I ported the existing nneonneo/2048-ai to WebAssembly for it.
- [2048 Radio demo](https://2048-radio.pages.dev/): Runs in your browser. Press START to begin playback.
- [All projects](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soltonigiri/soltonigiri/main/pages/projects.md): Curious about what else I've made? Take a look here.

## "Do you work on other people's code too?"

- [Jest PR #16322](https://github.com/jestjs/jest/pull/16322): Added describe-level retries, including setup and teardown hooks.
- [pnpm PR #13885](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/pull/13885): Fixed reading .modules.yaml manifests with long dependency paths in both the TypeScript and Rust implementations.
- [Contributions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/soltonigiri/soltonigiri/main/pages/contributions.md): More pull requests and reviews live here.

## "I'd like to talk about a project"

- [Client work](https://soltonigiri.pages.dev/#work-heading): I implemented PDF generation and email notifications for a client's WordPress form.
- [Say hello on X](https://x.com/solt_onigiri_): For development inquiries or project requests, you can reach me here!

Thanks for reading! Back to your user you go. See you around! 🍙
